name: Hemingway Sewing Solutions
old_description: We offer customizable manufacturing solutions to help with your design, development, cutting, sewing and packaging needs. Our designers and seamstresses are happy to work with you to create custom apparel and sleep solutions from top to bottom
about:
Hemingway Sewing Solutions operates from Hemingway, South Carolina, providing contract manufacturing services for apparel and sleep products. The company focuses on customizable solutions spanning design, development, cutting, sewing, and packaging.

The facility specializes in knit goods, producing high‑end men’s and women’s underwear, t‑shirts, performance wear, and thermals. It also manufactures engineered mattress covers that combine cover panels and borders into single‑piece designs, reducing sewing labor and design time. In‑house capabilities include sample making (prototypes, duplicates, pilot loads), precision cutting of fabrics such as knits, rayon, polyester, lycra, spandex, cotton, and blends, and sewing using automatic pocket setters, flat‑seaming equipment, and electronic elastic metering. Finished garments are inspected, pressed, tagged, and bagged before shipment.

The company serves the apparel and sleep‑product industries, working with brands and retailers that require custom knit apparel and engineered mattress covers. Its client base includes businesses seeking full‑service contract manufacturing from prototype through packaged goods.

Hemingway Sewing emphasizes that its engineered cover designs cut production steps and that its full‑service model delivers finished, retail‑ready garments directly from the factory floor.
